name: rejection
description: A perception that someone has denied an important aspect of your social value.
perceptions: I had wanted to be socially valued for a specific characteristic or output.
Someone has indicated this thing is not valued.
results: Maybe you'll try again, maybe you'll need a period of recovery, or maybe you'll give up on this path to being valued.
examples: The publisher refuses to publish your book.
You don't get the job even after 3 interviews.

guidance.description: Here’s why rejection hurts so much and some expert-approved tips for moving forward and finding emotional strength.

comparisons.description: 'Humiliation' is type of rejection where someone actively judges you negatively in a public way. More generally, 'rejection' can be triggered even by a polite 'no thanks' or being ignored.

commentaries.quote: These rejections hurt me terribly because I felt it was my life that was being rejected.
I take rejection as someone blowing a bugle in my ear to wake me up and get going, rather than retreat.
A clear rejection is always better than a fake promise.
If you live for people’s acceptance, you will die from their rejection.
I love my rejection slips. They show me I try.
